en.title: The Windowside Mender and the Forgotten Promise
en.premise: Welcome to "Kotokoto," a mysterious cafe that does more than just fix broken objects—it gently mends the hearts of those who visit. One day, a spirited child named Chibi brings in an old pocket watch with stopped hands. As the shopkeeper, Momo, and their companions trace the mystery of the watch, they discover a "lost letter" that someone had once carefully hidden away. Like stitching together a small fray, a tender truth begins to unfold.

zh.title: 窗边的缝补屋与被遗忘的约定
zh.premise: “Kotokoto”是一家不可思议的咖啡店，这里不仅能修复损坏的物品，还能轻轻抚慰主人的心境。某天，活力十足的チビ带来了一块指针停止转动的旧怀表。在追寻怀表之谜的过程中，店主モモ一行人偶然发现了某人曾精心隐藏的“失落的信件”。如同缝补细小的破绽一般，温柔的真相在一点点揭开。
